source.mob_location: along the coast of the Stormhaven area
source.notes: The skins drop off sandsharks along the coast of the Stormhaven area (west part of Qeynos Prison zone). The sharks seem to congregate around the little islands where the oceanic rats and Darkwood Bandits are, though you can find them anywhere along the coast. They tend to be swimming amongst the large moray eels and the poisonbite anglers.
